Vintage comedy drama, starring George Cole and Dennis Waterman

events.name: Benidorm
events.description: Joyce is furious with Sam and Monty after Sammy's disastrous performances in Neptunes, and she soon finds out that Monty has given him a Solana contract. Meanwhile, Doreen jumps the gun by sending Pauline's novel to be published, and Sheron and Billy take a trip down memory lane and spend a day reliving their youth. Elsewhere, Denis and Nigel are increasingly reluctant to arrest Lesley, and Mateo worries about having to go on another concubine cruise with Crystal Hennessy-Vass

events.name: Ashes to Ashes
events.description: A serial arsonist targets sites related to the 1983 general election. After risking his life in a burning building following a quiet word from Keats, Ray gets personally involved in the high-profile investigation - which forces him to face his traumatic past as it becomes clear the tragic events of the Falklands War are driving the firestarter to murder. Fantasy drama, with Dean Andrews and Joe Absolom (Doc Martin)

Suzi Quatro and Derek Fowlds guest star, with George Cole and Dennis Waterman

events.name: Benidorm
events.description: Monty is in need of a new job after being sacked by Joyce, and has to decide whether to swallow his pride and go to Sir Henry, or see if Mr Wu has a fitting position for him. Meanwhile, Loretta and Eddie make secret plans for an anniversary party for Billy and Sheron back in the UK, but it looks as if the couple are making plans of their own. Elsewhere, things are not going well for Kenneth as he wakes up in Blow & Go after a big night out, only to realise that the builders have inadvertently bricked him in

events.name: Benidorm
events.description: In the final episode, a strike at the airport causes panic at the Solana, and the Dawsons rush to catch their flight with their anniversary plans now in jeopardy as they may not make it back to the UK to celebrate. Meanwhile, Kenneth is on a warpath for Temple-Savage after his accidental imprisonment the previous day, and Joyce worries about the rumours that Crystal Hennessy-Vass may be letting the Solana go. Elsewhere, Sam's old flame Angelo is in town, and misunderstandings are finally resolved between Monty and Joyce

Elsewhere, things are not going well for Kenneth as he wakes up in Blow & Go after a big night out, only to realise that the builders have inadvertently bricked him in
